case_set_definition: all = every case; dvt_yes / dvt_no = cases whose DVT_Presence in /LARGE0/gr10478/b37974/Pulmonary_Hypertension/cteph_agp3k.v6/info/cteph_agp3k.v6.20260507.xlsx is Yes / No (Unknown or blank: in 'all' only); these three against all of the cohort's controls. dvt_case_only = the dvt_yes and dvt_no cases only, no controls, PHENO1 recoded 1 = DVT yes / 0 = DVT no: the test of a difference between the two
cohort_nesting: narrow_mainland is a strict subset of intermediate_mainland is a strict subset of full_mainland; they differ mainly in controls. Agreement across cohorts is a sample-selection sensitivity analysis, not replication.
markers: hla.typing.v2 results/06.assoc_inputs/<cohort>/{allele,residue}_dosage.tsv, read unchanged (md5 checked against summary.json); 2-field alleles and amino-acid residues at IMGT positions; 0/1/2 copies, blank = undetermined
coding: VCF hard calls, REF A = copy does not carry the marker, ALT P = copy carries it; effects are per copy carrying the marker
positions: chromosome 6, gene start (RefSeq hg38_refGene, union of chr6 transcripts) + rank of the marker within its gene; labels, not physical residue positions
fixed_model: plink2 --glm omit-ref no-firth hide-covar --ci 0.95 on the 12_model_inputs fixed_model sample set (relatives removed) restricted to the case set; complete case per marker
random_model: SAIGE step 2 (--LOCO=TRUE --chrom=6 --AlleleOrder=alt-first --is_Firth_beta=FALSE --impute_method=mean --maxMissing=0.15 --minMAC=0.5) on the case set's samples
null_models: all: analysis/assoc_saige 'main' null model, reused. dvt_yes / dvt_no / dvt_case_only: fitted here with SAIGE step 1 (binary, full GRM, LOCO, isDiagofKinSetAsOne, 200 variance-ratio markers, SEX + 10 PCs) on the random_model genotypes restricted to analysis/assoc_saige 00.prep/grm.prune.in and the case set's samples. Every null model checked against its case set (CHECK_NULL).
random_model_p: p = p.value.NA (no SPA), as in the genome-wide SAIGE scan; p_spa = p.value kept as a secondary column; se = 1/sqrt(var), consistent with p.value.NA; OR = exp(BETA)
tests: per (case set, cohort, class): markers polymorphic in the case set's random-model samples; two residues at one IMGT position whose dosages are complements in every sample (a mirror pair) count as one test
significance: Per (case set, cohort, class), family-wise 0.05 over the tests, the same for both models, fixed before any P: PRIMARY LD-adjusted p < 0.05 / Me, Me = effective number of independent tests from GEC v0.2 (Li et al. 2012, standalone release archived in tools/gec-0.2, sha256 checked; --maf 0, on the case set's fixed-model = unrelated samples); VALIDATION exact max-T threshold (the 0.05 quantile of the minimum P under a multivariate normal with the correlation of the covariate-adjusted, mean-imputed dosages of the random-model samples; 400000 draws, seed 20261023); SENSITIVITY conventional Bonferroni p < 0.05 / tests. No Benjamini-Hochberg. Not corrected across case sets, cohorts or models. lambda_GC reported, never applied.
benchmark: MAXT_BOOT, no call depends on it: per (case set, cohort, class), 10000 null phenotypes drawn by parametric bootstrap from the null logistic model (PHENO1 ~ 1 + SEX + PC1-10) fitted on the case set's fixed-model = unrelated samples; on every replicate, the tests (one per mirror pair) rerun as plink2 Wald tests with the fixed model's settings and as score tests without SPA (blanks mean-imputed; the random model's statistic without the GRM); exact threshold = the 0.05 quantile of the smallest P; the family-wise error rate of the GEC and Bonferroni thresholds = the share of replicates whose smallest P is below them; seed 20261023
omnibus: MAIN ANALYSIS, OMNIBUS: per case set, each residue position tested as a whole in the fixed model (the case set's unrelated samples, PHENO1 ~ 1 + SEX + PC1-10); gene-level omnibus tests over alleles are not run: categories = the position's residues plus 'unlisted' (copies the matrix does not list); a category < 1 % joins 'rare', a 'rare' pool < 0.5 % joins the reference (the most frequent category); likelihood-ratio test with df = the rank the unit adds; Bonferroni 0.05 / units tested per cohort; a separated or unfinished fit is never significant; independent units selected stepwise over the three cohorts with the rule of STEPWISE, conditioning on every category of the entered units; summary beside the single-marker scans in _omnibus/
consistency: random model (primary): per threshold and class, the number of the three nested cohorts in which a marker is significant with the same direction of effect, written n/3 (1/3 = Single cohort); a sample-selection sensitivity analysis, not replication. The fixed model is shown for effect sizes and model concordance
conditional: with the scan's own engine on a pooled PLINK set per (case set, cohort) (alleles + residues + the GWAS MHC lead[s] + a SENTINEL first record that absorbs a SAIGE --condition defect on the first marker). (1) STEPWISE per (case set, model, class), the three cohorts jointly: candidates = markers significant at the cohort's GEC threshold in at least one cohort, conditional on the signals entered; lead = the candidate with the smallest largest-P over the cohorts; at most 5 signals; members = markers significant before a lead entered and in no cohort after; carrier alleles of a residue lead from hla.typing.v2 allele_match_map + residue_reference. (2) CONDITIONAL per (case set, cohort, model): every HLA marker given each GWAS lead; each GWAS lead given single HLA markers (top 10 by |r|, top 10 by marginal P, the signal leads of both classes) and given the signal leads jointly; and given WHOLE POSITIONS (every residue column but the most frequent) for the positions of the residue signal leads and the omnibus position leads
gwas_leads: analysis/assoc_saige 'main' (SAIGE, SEX + 10 bbj_mainland PCs, p.value.NA): peaks overlapping chr6:28510120-33480577 whose lead has P < 0.00001 in every cohort; genotypes from 12_model_inputs random_model. Missing lead calls are mean-imputed here (best_guess in the genome-wide scan), so the lead's marginal P here differs slightly from the scan's
independence: designed and run without reading any file, script, null model or result of analysis/assoc_hla
figures: results/figures/0N.<family>/, one README.md per family. Main: 01.landscape (bars.<case_set>.png: one bar per test spanning its P over the three cohorts, coloured by n/3 at GEC; manhattan.<case_set>.png: the cohorts as rows), 02.signals, 03.conditioning (conditioning.png, carriers.png), 04.gwas_link, 05.dvt. Supplementary: 06.thresholds, 07.models, 08.qq. Random model throughout except 07.models
